name: Lamb Shepherd’s Pie with Peas and Potato Topping

components.name: Lamb Shepherd’s Pie

ingredients.name: Beef or lamb stock instead of wine
Worcestershire sauce, ensure suitable anchovy allergy tag

steps: Peel and boil potatoes until very tender. Drain thoroughly; mash with butter, milk and salt, then allow steam to escape.
In a wide skillet soften onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil. Brown lamb mince, breaking apart lumps and draining any excess rendered fat.
Stir flour and tomato paste through the lamb; gradually add stock, Worcestershire and herbs. Simmer until thick, then stir through peas.
Heat oven to 200 C. Spread lamb mixture in a deep baking dish and gently spoon mashed potato over the top without mixing the layers.
Rough up potato top with a fork, sprinkle cheddar and bake 25-30 minutes until edges bubble and top browns.
Cool slightly before dividing into six complete servings. Freeze slices once chilled if needed.
